description: Poseidon's MCP server answering at a live loopback endpoint with one tool shaped like the gateway's browser_open (not read-only, open world): the model calls it, the CLI asks with mcpServer/elicitation/request (codex_approval_kind mcp_tool_call), the card allows it once, and the call runs.
prompts: Call the browser_open tool of the poseidon MCP server once with url https://example.com, then reply with one word.
